en: A vintage postcard-style image showing a long, pale-colored classical building with many windows and an arched entrance in the center. The foreground is shaded by large tree branches and leaves, with a cobblestone courtyard in front of the building. The style suggests an old town or historic castle complex. At the bottom of the card, printed text reads "TALLINN." on the left and "Loss." on the right.
